Extract Comprehensive Cell-Level Properties

Source: R/01_metrics_distribution.R
extract_cell_properties.Rd

Computes library size, log-library size, zero fraction / detection frequency, pairwise cell correlation (on top HVGs), cell k-NN hubness, pairwise PCA distance, and outlier proportions.

Usage

extract_cell_properties(
  data,
  max_cells_cor = 1000,
  n_top_hvgs = 500,
  modality = NULL,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

Count matrix (features x cells) or SingleCellExperiment object.

max_cells_cor

Maximum number of cells for computing pairwise correlation (default 1000).

n_top_hvgs

Number of highly variable genes/peaks to use for correlation and PCA (default 500).

modality

Optional modality string (e.g. "scRNA-seq", "scATAC-seq"). When ATAC/peaks are provided or auto-detected, cell correlations and PCA use Signac/simPIC TF-IDF normalization instead of log2(CPM + 1).

verbose

Logical, whether to print progress messages.

Value

A named list of 10 cell-level property summaries:

library_size

Numeric vector of total counts per cell.

log_library_size

Numeric vector of log(library_size + 1).

tmm_factor

Numeric vector of TMM normalization factors per cell.

effective_library_size

Numeric vector of library_size * tmm_factor.

zero_fraction_cell

Numeric vector of per-cell zero count proportions.

detection_freq_cell

Numeric vector of per-cell non-zero feature proportions (1 - zero_fraction_cell).

cell_cor

Numeric vector of upper-triangle pairwise Spearman correlations across cells.

pca_dist

Numeric vector of pairwise Euclidean distances between cells in top PCA space.

knn_hubness

Numeric vector giving how often each cell appears among other cells' 5% nearest neighbors.

prop_outliers_cell

Numeric scalar proportion of cells flagged as library-size outliers via Tukey IQR.

Examples

data(example_scrna, package = "scSimEval")
extract_cell_properties(example_scrna$ref)
